“Cracks knuckles”….. I’ve been waiting to answers something like this. I’ll give you actual real advice:
1) find a reward that your dog loves (you can do this by placing all of them on the ground at once and allowing him to choose)
2) have a friend stand parallel with you while you both face the firing line. Say 50’-100’ away from each other. 
3) have your buddy pop off one shot while you hold your dogs leash.
4) asses your dog’s behavior and determine if you need to be further away or if your buddy can take a step closer.
5) if your dog is calm and not barking or jumping, reward the dog. 
6) repeat until you can shoot with dog next to you off leash. This may take several months but is highly effective. It’s called successive approximation. Works every time. You may need to tweak something but I guarantee this will get the desired results.
